trust_decision.summary: Driver-returned error text (often from a remote control-panel / poppassd server) is trusted as HTML: password::_save concatenates it raw into $reason, which goes to display_message and is inserted client-side with jQuery .html().

landing_point.why: Summary says driver error text was concatenated into the message; the only concatenation of the driver 'message' is in password::_save.

fix_sites.entry_point: same action, with password_driver=directadmin (driver save() response parsing)
fix_sites.module_kind: backend driver (removal of strip_tags to avoid double handling)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The directadmin change only removes a now-redundant strip_tags (fix.diff:52-53); the real fix is the single escape in password.php:410. Drivers cpanel.php:108, domainfactory.php:79, plesk.php:231, poppassd.php:33 feed remote text into the same sink and are all covered by that one escape.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For O8 routes: no bundled driver implements compare(), and the bundled check_strength() drivers (pwned, zxcvbn) return only localized/library strings, so a solver can argue those paths carry no remote or attacker text.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: display_message renders HTML deliberately for many core and plugin messages, and strength rules carry an intended link (pwned_mustnotbedisclosed has <a href>). Escaping globally in app.js display_message, or escaping strength_rules output, would break these. The localized $reason prefix must stay readable.

O6_input_shapes: string 'message' in an array result {code,message} returned by save() (plugins/password/password.php:384-386)

O7_producer.where: Driver save() methods produce the text (e.g. plugins/password/drivers/poppassd.php:33, plugins/password/drivers/cpanel.php:108). These are handlers, not a schema/serializer, and _save calls them directly at plugins/password/password.php:381.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: check_strength() reason from the strength driver is appended raw to the error shown by display_message
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Bundled strength drivers return only gettext/zxcvbn library strings (plugins/password/drivers/pwned.php:102-104, plugins/password/drivers/zxcvbn.php:65); this is a strength check, not a save error.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 45 lines above the fix site

O8_uncovered_routes.route: driver compare() result is passed raw to display_message
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: No bundled driver implements compare(); the README documents it as optional (plugins/password/README:482-488).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; output at plugins/password/password.php:164 and :171

O8b_injection_room.sibling: include the upstream API's HTTP error body or status text in the fetch-error reason returned by check_strength
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding diagnostics to 'Failed to verify the password strength' would plausibly append the remote response, and that output reaches password.php:365 unescaped.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a compare() method in a control-panel driver that returns the panel's verification error text
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The README documents compare() as a driver hook, and panel APIs return human-readable error strings.

O9_family: XSS (CWE-79): unescaped backend/driver text into an HTML message sink

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x + composer (PHPUnit); JS client is plain app.js
O10_build.project_tests: plugins/password/tests/PasswordTest.php (driver/_save tests with mocked drivers; see its error_message case at :60-64)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add strip_tags/htmlspecialchars inside the one driver they reproduce with (e.g. cpanel or poppassd) instead of escaping at the shared _save sink, or escape globally in app.js display_message.

out_of_scope_notes: password_disabled string config is rendered raw at plugins/password/password.php:279; it is admin-controlled config, not pursued.
Pinned tree is the 1.7/master line; commit 94298856 is the 1.6 backport and 26d1b077/1dd91052 are unrelated (CS fix, test asset).
unverified: Whether the server-side output->command('display_message') path applies any encoding before app.js .html() was not traced through program/include; the advisory and fix imply it does not.

j_defence_ineffective=1 rests on directadmin's strip_tags existing as a per-driver partial defence (plugins/password/drivers/directadmin.php:83) while other drivers had none; whether strip_tags itself was bypassable was not checked.
present_in_latest unknown: no latest release given.
How-type room is low: the fix is one escape at a shared sink; O8 routes are WHERE-type and carry only driver/library text in the bundled code.
